description: Deprecated: use watch with kind keyword (also reports rank moves as events). Starts tracking the search ranking of terms in one or both stores and the given countries: ranked apps are captured daily from now on (idempotent; already tracked terms are reported as such). Each term × store × country uses one keyword slot of the plan; a request over the limit tracks nothing (plan_limit). Read history with get_keyword_ranks. Cost: 0 credits.

countries.description: Two-letter country codes to track in (default ['us'])

depth.description: How many results to keep per ranking (default 100 Apple / 50 Play).

format.description: 'markdown' (default): compact tables for reading. 'json': the API's raw { data, meta }

store.description: 'apple', 'play' or 'both' (tracks each term in each store)

terms.description: Search terms to track, e.g. ['habit tracker', 'streaks']

name: track_keywords
title: Track Keywords
